takeaway: First-degree AV block means an abnormality at the AV node, which is situated in the right atrium.

lines.text: A thirty-five-year-old man has a routine annual medical examination for his employment.
His ECG shows prolongation of the PR interval, to more than 0.22 seconds.
lines.say: His E C G shows prolongation of the P R interval, to more than nought point two two seconds.

lines.text: A prolonged PR interval like this is first-degree AV block.
lines.say: A prolonged P R interval like this is first-degree A V block.

lines.text: First-degree AV block indicates an abnormality at the AV node.
lines.say: First-degree A V block indicates an abnormality at the A V node.

lines.text: And the AV node is situated in the right atrium.
lines.say: And the A V node is situated in the right atrium.

lines.text: So the abnormal part of the conducting system lies in the right atrium.
